summary: This task successfully completed a service desk SLA audit using the existing spreadsheet-audit-reporting skill patterns. The agent followed the established workflow correctly, creating a 3-sheet Excel workbook (RawData, Formatted Data, Summary) and a Word executive brief. Key patterns observed: SLA Breach detection against tiered thresholds from a separate SLA_Rules sheet, Missing Escalation detection for required-but-absent escalation codes, and aggregation by (Queue, Region). The trace shows successful reuse of existing patterns with no failures or verifier mismatches. The skill should be extended to document SLA audit variants where thresholds come from a reference/rules sheet rather than hardcoded values.
